result.title: Risk-Aware Adaptive Evaluation: Finding High-Impact Failures Under Limited Budgets
result.comment: Accepted to 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Evaluation of Interactive Agents
result.summary: Evaluating interactive agents is expensive. Agent behavior is stochastic, so reliability must be measured over repeated trials, but failures are rare and differ widely in how much they matter. Standard benchmarks spend this budget uniformly: a read-only lookup is sampled as often as an irreversible payment action. We instead formulate evaluation as a sequential allocation problem. Given a fixed trial budget and a set of scenarios whose failure behavior is unknown, which scenarios should be run, and run again? We propose a risk-aware contextual Thompson Sampling policy that combines a pre-execution scenario context vector and a fixed impact score with the failure outcomes observed during evaluation, and we test it by offline replay over 70 $τ$-bench airline scenarios and 824 recorded trials. Our main result is at the smallest budget: with only 50 trials ($6\%$ of the corpus), the policy recovers $86\%$ of the impact-weighted failures an oracle could find, compared to $25\%$ for uniform allocation. It discovers $3.5\times$ more impact-weighted failures (215.4 vs. 62.2) with the same number of trials, delivers $5\times$ the discovery per dollar, and cuts the budget wasted on scenarios that never fail from $34\%$ to $2.8\%$. The rest of our analysis demonstrates and qualifies this result: a budget sweep shows the advantage shrinks as the budget approaches the corpus size, and paired significance tests show that scenario context helps mainly at small budgets while posterior-based exploration helps at moderate ones. Risk-aware adaptive allocation therefore helps most exactly where evaluation budget is scarcest.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文把交互式智能体的评测预算分配建模为序贯决策问题，提出风险感知的情境 Thompson Sampling 策略，结合场景上下文、影响分数与观测到的失败结果来决定重跑哪些场景，并在 τ-bench 航空场景上离线重放验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预算有限时选择哪些场景继续采样」的序贯分配与证据获取思路，可能启发 LVR 中动态计算与 STOP 决策的资源分配；但工作聚焦评测采样，未涉及 latent 状态或视觉推理，可供核查的具体线索有限。
